propositions: Hand-maintained help artifacts drift from the true runtime parser factories and must be replaced with deterministically generated canonical artifacts derived from the immutable route registry and enriched parser descriptions.

The `scripts/gen_cli_help.py` generator with `--check` mode must validate that all help artifacts are complete, stale-free, deterministic, and free of blank per-command summaries before RP-04 operation/config/mount boundaries.

Help surface readers outside `src/rebar/_cli/help/` (_scripts, tests, production help renderers) must remain valid by preserving the capitalized `Usage:` prefix byte-for-byte and regenerating bodies from true factory grammar.

The lexical pre-scan in `_cli/__init__.py` must resolve top-level help and unknown routing to committed artifacts before any operation composition, config materialization, store creation, or parser/handler resolution.
